payload.body: You tend to defend a belief strongly in front of other people and then question the whole idea when you are alone. At other times, someone else's certainty makes you reject a view you partly share. Underneath is often an old lesson that conviction had to be impressive, complete, or publicly approved before it counted. Say what you know and what you are still unsure about in the same conversation.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Jupiter can make certainty become larger in public and less stable in private.
